title: Hof last-applied deployment state
description: /var/lib/hof/state/current.json - the authoritative record of what hofctl apply last actually did. Written only by a fully successful apply (out of scope for delivery item 7); hofctl plan reads it as the baseline for its desired diff. Never holds secrets or plaintext environment values - digests and identifiers only.

installationId.description: Assigned once, at first successful bootstrap, and never changed for the lifetime of this installation - it's what ties Docker resources (via the hof.installation-id label) back to this state file.

generation.description: This schema validates only a real, on-disk current.json - the synthetic bootstrap baseline (generation 0) is an in-memory object of hofctl's own and is never written to disk or validated against this schema, so a real current.json claiming generation 0 is itself a sign of corruption or tampering, not a legitimate first apply (that's generation 1).

generatedArtifacts.description: Filename -> sha256 for every file hofctl render produced (compose.yml, Caddyfile, service.env, ...) - lets a drift check notice a generated file was hand-edited after the fact.

retainedServices.description: Item 9 (ADR 0005): a persistent service disabled with dataRetention: retain, keyed by service id - its own volume name and the schema version it was last migrated to, carried forward so a later re-enable reuses the same volume and never re-runs a migration against data already at the current schema. Optional and absent (never merely {}) on state written before this item, and on any installation that has never retained a service - resolveBaseline() treats a missing key the same as {}.

retainedAt.description: When this entry was first written - carried forward unchanged on every later commit that still retains the same service; set fresh only the one commit that actually disables it. Optional: plan.mjs's own pure planning core never reads the clock, so a freshly-planned retain entry has no value here yet - apply.mjs fills it in at real commit time.
